魅惑1名敌人2回合：攻击与负面状态转向同伴，无同伴则转向自身；增益转给你。: Charm 1 enemy for 2 turns. Its attacks and debuffs target other enemies, or itself if alone. Its buffs go to you.
魅惑没有加入永久牌组，收据应保留待重试。: Charm was not added to the permanent deck. Retain the receipt for retry.
开战失去1力量；每次强化再失去1。: Lose 1 Strength at combat start. Each upgrade loses 1 more.
开战失去1敏捷；每次强化再失去1。: Lose 1 Dexterity at combat start. Each upgrade loses 1 more.
敌人每回合获得2格挡；每次强化+2。: Enemies gain 2 Block each turn. Each upgrade adds 2.
开战获得1回合虚弱；每次强化+1回合。: Gain 1 turn of Weak at combat start. Each upgrade adds 1 turn.
每回合攻击伤害随机为80%～110%。每次强化降低下限5%，最低50%。: Attack damage is randomly multiplied by 80%–110% each turn. Each upgrade lowers the minimum by 5%, down to 50%.
起手加入2张杂念，回合结束消耗；每次强化多1张。: Add 2 Clutter cards to your opening hand; they Exhaust at end of turn. Each upgrade adds 1 card.
敌人开战获得1力量；每次强化+1。: Enemies gain 1 Strength at combat start. Each upgrade adds 1.
敌人每回合获得3覆甲；每次强化+1。: Enemies gain 3 Plated Armor each turn. Each upgrade adds 1.
敌人初始生命+10%；每次强化再+10%。: Enemies start with 10% more HP. Each upgrade adds another 10%.
每张攻击牌对每名敌人首次造成未格挡伤害时，受到1反伤；每次强化+1。: The first time each Attack card deals unblocked damage to each enemy, take 1 retaliatory damage. Each upgrade adds 1.
前3回合，敌人每回合最多损失40%最大生命；每次强化降低5%，最低20%。: For the first 3 turns, enemies can lose at most 40% of their Max HP per turn. Each upgrade reduces this by 5%, down to 20%.
敌人每次行动结束获得1力量；每次强化+1。: Enemies gain 1 Strength after each action. Each upgrade adds 1.
首回合获得1能量，但不能获得格挡。: Gain 1 Energy on turn 1, but you cannot gain Block.
首回合多1能量、抽1张牌；第二回合各减少1。: Gain 1 Energy and draw 1 extra card on turn 1; gain 1 less of each on turn 2.
战斗金币+25%；起手少抽1张牌，至少抽1张。: Gain 25% more combat Gold. Draw 1 fewer card in your opening hand, minimum 1.
每回合首张手动牌费用翻倍，第三张手动牌额外打出一次。: Each turn, the first manually played card costs twice as much; the third is played an additional time.
每获得1张永久牌，随机将1张原有牌变为其他角色的同稀有度牌，保留升级；每次强化多: Whenever you obtain a permanent card, transform 1 random pre-existing card into a card of the same rarity from another character, keeping upgrades. Each upgrade transforms 1 more card.
每回合获得1能量，同时获得3灾厄。: Gain 1 Energy and 3 Doom each turn.
每次卡牌奖励可多选1张。永久牌有8耐久，打出消耗1；耗尽后枯萎，可在营地修复。: Choose 1 additional card from each card reward. Permanent cards have 8 durability and lose 1 per play. At 0, they Wither. Repair at a Rest Site.
进入下一节点时，获得期间单个对手最高金币收入的50%，上限30；每次强化上限+5: At your next node, gain 50% of the highest Gold income earned by a single opponent since the previous node, up to 30. Each upgrade raises the cap by 5. Transfers and mode Gold do not count.
每次战斗胜利，按开战时携带的不同诅咒获得金币：普通1、精英3、Boss5。同名只: After each victory, gain Gold for each distinct Curse held at combat start: Normal 1, Elite 3, Boss 5. Duplicate Curses and Contracts do not count. Race cap: 800; each upgrade adds 400.
每次取得叠1层，最多3层。开战时每层获得1力量、1敏捷、1集中。: Gain 1 stack per acquisition, up to 3. At combat start, gain 1 Strength, 1 Dexterity, and 1 Focus per stack.
接下来1场战斗起手多抽1张牌；落后至少一幕时延长至2场。: Draw 1 extra card in your opening hand for 1 combat; lasts 2 combats if at least one act behind.
敌人塞入的状态牌会转发给对手，在其下场战斗加入；每名对手最多待收5张。: Status cards added by enemies are forwarded to opponents for their next combat. Up to 5 pending cards per opponent.
收到献祭诅咒时，施加者获得1张诅咒牌；每名施加者最多2张，每次强化上限+1。: When you receive a sacrifice Curse, its sender gains 1 Curse card, up to 2 per sender. Each upgrade raises the cap by 1.
每场可放弃1次卡牌奖励，获得10金币和下场首回合2能量；每次强化金币+2。: Once per combat, skip a card reward to gain 10 Gold and 2 Energy on turn 1 of your next combat. Each upgrade adds 2 Gold.
每胜利1场，攻击伤害与格挡+1%；每次强化使每胜加成再+0.1%。计入本局此前胜: Gain 1% attack damage and Block per victory. Each upgrade adds 0.1% per victory. Includes earlier victories in this race.
每复活1次，最大生命、攻击伤害与格挡+10%；每次强化使每次加成再+1%。计入本: Gain 10% Max HP, attack damage, and Block per revival. Each upgrade adds 1% per revival. Includes earlier revivals in this race.
下场开战移出全部技能牌；此后每胜任选1张取回。净化时返还余牌。: Remove all Skills at the start of your next combat. After each victory, recover 1 of your choice. Cleansing returns all remaining Skills.
非战斗时点击：失去3最大生命，移除1张牌。可重复使用，至少保留1最大生命。: Click outside combat: lose 3 Max HP to remove 1 card. Repeatable; must leave at least 1 Max HP.
所有玩家从下场战斗起无法升级卡牌，包括施加者。保留已有升级，可被诅咒护盾抵挡。: Starting next combat, all players, including the sender, can no longer upgrade cards. Existing upgrades remain. Can be blocked by a Curse Shield.
点击购买对手的1张牌，金币交给原主人。100金币起，每次购买涨50；双方在各自下: Click to buy 1 card from an opponent, paying its original owner. Starts at 100 Gold, rising by 50 per purchase. Transfers at each player's next combat start.
非战斗时点击：保留物品和状态，回到第一幕。怪物生命、伤害、格挡+20%，可累加；: Click outside combat: return to Act 1 with your items and state. Monsters gain 20% HP, damage, and Block, stacking per reset. All later Boss rewards count as first kills. Gain 1 use per acquisition.
开战获得1力量；每次强化+1。: Gain 1 Strength at combat start. Each upgrade adds 1.
开战获得1敏捷；每次强化+1。: Gain 1 Dexterity at combat start. Each upgrade adds 1.
开战获得6格挡；每次强化+3。: Gain 6 Block at combat start. Each upgrade adds 3.
首回合多抽1张牌；每次强化+1。: Draw 1 extra card on turn 1. Each upgrade adds 1.
每场胜利恢复2生命；每次强化+1。: Heal 2 HP after each victory. Each upgrade adds 1.
开战获得1回合脆弱；每次强化+1回合。: Gain 1 turn of Frail at combat start. Each upgrade adds 1 turn.
开战获得1回合易伤；每次强化+1回合。: Gain 1 turn of Vulnerable at combat start. Each upgrade adds 1 turn.
开战失去2生命，至少保留1；每次强化多失去1。不触发失血收益。: Lose 2 HP at combat start, leaving at least 1. Each upgrade loses 1 more. Does not trigger HP-loss benefits.
每回合首次手动先打攻击再打技能，获得4格挡；每次强化+2。: Once per turn, manually playing an Attack followed by a Skill grants 4 Block. Each upgrade adds 2.
每回合首次手动打出实付至少2能量的攻击，抽1张牌；每次强化增加1次本场额外抽1张: Once per turn, manually playing an Attack for at least 2 actual Energy draws 1 card. Each upgrade grants 1 additional bonus draw per combat.
回合开始时，若生命不高于一半，获得8格挡并抽1张牌。每场1次；每次强化格挡+4。: Once per combat, at turn start, if at or below half HP, gain 8 Block and draw 1 card. Each upgrade adds 4 Block.
每手动打出4张牌，所有存活敌人获得3格挡；每次强化+2。: Every 4 cards manually played, all living enemies gain 3 Block. Each upgrade adds 2.
每场首次重洗弃牌堆时，在抽牌堆加入2张临时晕眩；每次强化多1张。: On the first discard-pile reshuffle each combat, add 2 temporary Dazed cards to the draw pile. Each upgrade adds 1.
开战获得2力量、2敏捷。普通治疗减半，营地治疗与复活不受影响。: Gain 2 Strength and 2 Dexterity at combat start. Normal healing is halved; Rest Site healing and revivals are unaffected.
每回合首次手动打出实付至少2能量的非X费攻击，额外打出1次，并失去2生命，至少保: Once per turn, manually playing a non-X Attack for at least 2 actual Energy plays it an additional time and loses 2 HP, leaving at least 1.
击杀精英累计悬赏，完成后获得1份可献祭遗物并重新累计。前两幕需3次，第三四幕2次: Earn bounty progress from Elite victories. Completing a bounty grants a relic that can be sacrificed, then starts a new bounty. Requires 3 victories in Acts 1–2, 2 in Acts 3–4, and 1 in Act 5. Reacquiring adds 1 progress.
每5胜储存1次免死，最多2次；重复取得补1次。触发后剩1生命，不能抵挡直接处决或: Store 1 death prevention charge per 5 victories, up to 2. Reacquiring restores 1 charge. Leaves 1 HP when triggered. Cannot block direct execution or voluntary HP payments.
开战生成1个随机充能球，此后每4回合再生成1个；每次强化间隔−1，最短1回合。: Channel 1 random Orb at combat start and every 4 turns after. Each upgrade reduces the interval by 1, minimum 1 turn.
攻击伤害的15%无视格挡；每次强化+5%，最多100%。: 15% of attack damage ignores Block. Each upgrade adds 5%, up to 100%.
对敌人造成实际伤害时，将其中20%传导给其余敌人；每次强化+5%。传导可被格挡，: When you deal actual damage to an enemy, conduct 20% of it to all other enemies. Each upgrade adds 5%. Conducted damage can be blocked and does not conduct again.
卡牌可再次升级，额外获得3点伤害、格挡或治疗；每次强化额外+1。仍受升级禁令限制: Cards can be upgraded again for an extra 3 damage, Block, or healing. Each upgrade adds 1 to this bonus. Upgrade bans still apply.
非战斗时点击：支付350金币，恢复已消耗的蜥蜴尾巴。可重复使用。: Click outside combat: pay 350 Gold to restore a spent Lizard Tail. Repeatable.
你施加给敌人的负面效果变为2倍；每次强化再+1倍。不会放大净化或重复计算临时属性: Debuffs you apply to enemies are multiplied by 2. Each upgrade adds 1 to the multiplier. Does not amplify cleansing or double-count temporary stat changes.
受到的攻击伤害−50%，每次强化再减5%，最多−80%。每一击锁定当前生命最高的: Take 50% less attack damage; each upgrade reduces it by another 5%, up to 80%. Each hit locks onto the enemy with the highest current HP; area attacks hit only that target.
造成与受到的伤害+10%。攻击有20%概率暴击，造成150%伤害；每次强化暴击率: Deal and take 10% more damage. Attacks have a 20% chance to critically hit for 150% damage. Each upgrade adds 5% critical chance, up to 50%. Area and multi-hit attacks share one roll per attack.
获得壁垒傀儡，代你承受攻击与负面状态，并接收你的格挡；你无法治疗。傀儡死亡后失去: Gain a defensive puppet that takes attacks and debuffs for you and receives your Block. You cannot heal. Lose this item when it dies; excess damage hits you. Each upgrade adds 25% of the puppet's initial HP as Max HP.
每3场胜利储存1次遁地，最多2次；每次强化少需1胜，最少1胜。使用时获得等同最大: Store 1 burrow charge per 3 victories, up to 2. Each upgrade reduces victories needed by 1, minimum 1. Using it grants Block equal to Max HP and ends your turn; emerge next turn. If Block breaks while burrowed, become Stunned for 1 turn.
体型翻倍。攻击斩杀最大生命低于你当前生命的敌人；每次强化斩杀阈值+10%。: Double your size. Attacks execute enemies whose Max HP is below your current HP. Each upgrade raises the execute threshold by 10%.
获得1张2费时间线卡，可打出对手牌组中任意1张牌的副本。每次取得再获得1张。: Gain a 2-cost Timeline card that plays a copy of any card from an opponent's deck. Each acquisition grants another card.
获得1张魅惑：2费，消耗。使敌人两回合内攻击与负面状态转向其他敌人，无其他敌人则: Gain a Charm: 2 Energy, Exhaust. For 2 turns, an enemy's attacks and debuffs target other enemies, or itself if alone; its buffs go to you. Each acquisition grants another card.
化身史莱姆。致命伤害使你分裂为两个史莱姆，各有你50%的最大生命，每张牌各打出一: Become a Slime. Lethal damage splits you into two Slimes, each with 50% of your Max HP; each card is played once per body. If either dies, you die. Each upgrade adds 5 percentage points, up to 75%.
非金币奖励可刷新1次；每次强化再+1次，最多3次。: Non-Gold rewards can be rerolled once. Each upgrade adds 1 reroll, up to 3.
